name: 39114 · Mendenhall, MS
findings: ZIP 39114 (Mendenhall) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39114 (Mendenhall) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
83% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
